details.report:
R1: Refactor `src/recorder/errors.ts` and `src/recorder/run.ts` so one typed unknown-failure builder derives a closed safe category and emits `internal-error` at the current truthful stage, while broad orchestration catches preserve only existing `RecorderError`s and otherwise rethrow/delegate to that builder. Keep specific classifications only in owners that prove them (`spawnOnce`, required cleanup, no-replace promotion, etc.); make lexical config-path conversion catch only a recognized `RecorderError("invalid-path")`; reclassify manifest implementation/invariant/schema/closure `admission-failed` producers in `src/recorder/manifest.ts` and `run.ts` as internal faults. Audit all affected catches and stage transitions (config read/structure/state, destination/staging, admission, spawn, extraction, generated storage/scanning, manifest, cleanup, promotion) so no stale stage or broad unknown-to-specific laundering remains.

R2: Rework `src/recorder/config.ts` parsing helpers to require an explicit typed `SchemaLocation` whenever constructing `invalid-config`; remove the constructor’s implicit `[]` fallback. Thread exact paths through root/object shapes, scalar/type/enum/lexical checks, environment overrides/unset entries and conflicts, declaration collection/item fields, provenance, archive, and execution. Use `[]` only for malformed JSON/root defects, containing-object paths for unknown keys, indexed later fields for duplicate/reserved declarations, and `["declarations"]` for missing authority/task. Update any affected path helper so post-parse invariant failures do not present as config defects.

R3: Define finite exported stage/category constants and derived TypeScript unions in `src/recorder/errors.ts`, centralize allow-listed cause categorization (stable buckets for known platform errors, other `Error`, and non-Error throws), and bound all diagnostics without exposing names/messages/stacks/values/argv/environment. Add `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json` as a closed schema for the exact stderr contract: finite codes/stages/categories, typed string-or-nonnegative-integer location segments, fixed/bounded public and child diagnostics, and conditional coherence for `not-spawned`, `exited`, and `signaled` exit/signal states, including non-null location only for `invalid-config`. Keep runtime serialization/types synchronized without runtime dependence on a packaged schema file.

R4: Split config handling into an entirely scanner-free structural pass followed by a credential-metadata scan pass and then stateful validation/admission. Move all shape/type/enum/lexical/uniqueness/reserved ID and generated-path/prefix/required authority-task/cross-field checks into the first pass, retaining source indices long enough for exact duplicate/reserved locations. Remove later duplicate ownership of those invariants from admission/path seams. Prove structural failures precede scanning, canonicalization, filesystem/repository/Git/content/hash/admission/stage/spawn work.

R5: Replace the blanket config-read catch in `src/recorder/config.ts` with narrow filesystem classification: recognized missing, inaccessible, and non-file paths become `invalid-path` with null location and an allow-listed safe category; malformed JSON remains root-located `invalid-config`; unknown read exceptions flow to the stage-aware internal builder. Preserve the untouched child outcome (`not-spawned`, null exit/signal/diagnostic).

R6: Close the Recorder JSON fence in `README.md` immediately after the example and link the shipped failure schema. Add table-driven production-seam coverage, primarily in Recorder CLI/transaction/admission/schema tests, for every Judge-listed exact location and ordering, credential canaries, recognized/unknown read failures, sentinel unknowns at allocation/admission/spawn/extraction/manifest build+schema/cleanup/promotion, owner-established specific errors, and exact not-spawned/exited/signaled truth. Validate actual bin stderr against the packaged schema and assert no raw constructor names, messages, stacks, secrets, attacker keys, argv, values, or environment leak. Deepen an existing owned seam only where ordinary production tests cannot induce a sentinel; do not retain a duplicate probe. Regenerate `dist/recorder/*`, then run focused Recorder tests, full `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build:recorder`, `npm pack --dry-run`, `git diff --check`, package-content/schema checks, and a broad-catch/unknown-to-specific search. Confirm only authorized files changed, preserve the historical root-cause non-claim and issue #13 exclusion in the repair receipt/body, and create one new forward commit (expected title prefix `fix(recorder):`) without amend or history rewrite. Historical check: prior `1db6c4c` introduced the broad wrappers, open diagnostics, partial locations, early metadata scanning, and unreadable-as-config behavior; this plan removes that failed method family rather than adding another wrapper layer.
